title: Bosun Logbook Journal Contract v1
description: Machine-readable schema contract for a Logbook (Realm 3: Calendar & Logs) daily scratchpad's YAML frontmatter. One journal note exists per calendar day at `locker_logbook/journals/YYYY-MM-DD.md`.

schema.description: Frontmatter type tag identifying this entity as a Logbook journal day, schema version 1.

date.description: Calendar date this journal covers, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Must match the file's `journals/YYYY-MM-DD.md` name.

tags.description: User tags associated with the day.

linked_events.description: Identifiers of `$logbook:event/v1` records synced for this day, for cross-reference only. The events themselves live in the disposable calendar cache/SQLite, not in git history.
